read.thesis: Q4 CY25 gross margin 62.3% and Q1 2026 revenue guide of US$34.6–35.8B with 63–65% gross margin, while 2026 capex budget of US$52–56B signals heavy investment rather than discipline.

capex.quote: The management further expects the 2026 capital budget to be between US$52 billion and US$56 billion.

triggers.label: Q1 revenue guide US$34.6–35.8B
triggers.quote: Revenue is expected to be between US$34.6 billion and US$35.8 billion;
triggers.highlight: Revenue is expected to be between US$34.6 billion and US$35.8 billion

triggers.label: Gross margin 62.3% in Q4
triggers.quote: Gross margin for the quarter was 62.3%, operating margin was 54.0%, and net profit margin was 48.3%.
triggers.highlight: Gross margin for the quarter was 62.3%

guidance.quote: Revenue is expected to be between US$34.6 billion and US$35.8 billion;
Gross profit margin is expected to be between 63% and 65%;
Operating profit margin is expected to be between 54% and 56%.
The management further expects the 2026 capital budget to be between US$52 billion and US$56 billion.
